_comment: What ASP.NET compiles at run time: a CodeFile page with App_Code's class, user controls of web.config's, the expressions, a postback; a theme's skins and style sheets (the directive's, another set in PreInit, a style sheet theme); the culture from the browser's languages and the resources it chooses (the browser's own language, a page's culture set in code, ja, fr, de with no resources of its, a language that is none: answered, not compared).

steps.name: codefile-a page and user controls compiled at run time, App_Code
codefile-a postback: the user controls' view state
theme-a style sheet theme with a theme
culture-Accept-Language de-DE (no resources of its own)
culture-Accept-Language of no culture: answered (its formats: .NET Framework's are the invariant culture's, ICU's its default locale's)
